messages:
maya: Heads-up, opening a PR to align examples: streaming returns chunk events, paginate param renamed to cursor, and add a tiny retry helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332

trent: nice. Can the Python example explicitly show assembling text from deltas? Lots of users expect a single final string.

maya: yeah, plan is to show both: canonical async iterator + a small sync wrapper for sync users.

hugo: for Go please include context timeout and proper error checks. One of our integration tests hung because examples didn't cancel.

ivy: I'll add a short "Advanced patterns" section with an exponential backoff snippet and note about batching -> higher p99.

trent: Python example suggestion:```py
buf = []
async for ev in client.stream(req):
    if ev.type == 'delta':
        buf.append(ev.text)
result = ''.join(buf)
```
and a sync helper that wraps an asyncio loop for quick demos.

hugo: Go snippet:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
  ev, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { /* handle transient vs fatal */ }
  // handle ev
}
```
note: import context, io, time.

ivy: TS snippet:```ts
let out = ''
for await (const ev of client.stream(req)) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') out += ev.text
}
```
callout: mention Node version support for for-await-of.

ci-bot: PR opened: docs#4332 1 reviewers requested: @trent @hugo. CI: docs-lint/examples queued.

maya: also swapped page_token -> cursor in the list APIs. Can someone grep for helpers that still use page_token?

hugo: found one Go helper, pushed a small rename commit.

trent: added a tiny migration blurb in breaking-changes.md showing the old vs new snippet.

ivy: pushed the backoff snippet and a brief note about when to prefer small batches vs latency.

maya: thanks all. Once CI passes I'll merge and then post a short heads-up in the release notes. Ping here if you spot any remaining page_token references.
